description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Change how the back office looks. Confirm colors with the owner in plain words first. Colors must be #RRGGBB and readable (too-light colors are refused with a suggestion). Free: display name, colors, tagline. Pro: logo_url (https png/svg/webp, 512 KB), login_message.

display_name.description: Name shown in headers and titles, 2-60 characters

login_message.description: Message on the sign-in page, up to 280 characters (Pro)

logo_url.description: https link to a PNG, SVG or WebP logo (Pro); empty string removes it

primary_color.description: Button color #RRGGBB (white text must stay readable)

tagline.description: Short line under the name, up to 100 characters

name: update_branding
